verifier_findings: The train.py-only patch implements one attributable change: compiled-branch Muon NS ownership using contiguous padded slices and one rank-ordered all_gather per partitioned group.

The extracted helpers preserve the source arithmetic, explicit tall/ns_steps arguments, return ordering, and optimizer-state rebinding. The original _muon_math, compiled fallback, eager/NKI branches, and backend precedence remain unchanged.
Default-on env/CLI control and once-per-group diagnostics are present. Diagnostics compare against the original compiled callable without applying reference updates to live state.

Data, tokenizer, forward/evaluation behavior, load_for_eval, checkpoint format, schedules, seed handling, and the 1800-second/full-chip launch contract are unchanged. No external-data or pretrained dependency is introduced.
Supplied deterministic checks pass. Numerical tolerances, collective execution, throughput, BPB, and causality results remain downstream runtime gates, not prerequisites for this implementation gate.
